targetTest: it keeps occurrences, an admin cancellation and the .ics UID when a save of a non-round-tripping rule is refused with data set "dataset "weekly Monday""
expected: For FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO and FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=2TU on a Friday start, a forced EditEvent save sends the unsupported-rule warning and a direct UpdatePublishedEvent call throws UNSUPPORTED_RULE_REFUSED; occurrence rows, the admin cancellation and the .ics UID line are unchanged
actual: No warning is sent: canEdit() judges the rule by shape only (tryFromRrule), so the page is editable and the save goes through (WR-10 reproduced); UpdatePublishedEvent does not throw; ManualRecurrence::tryFromStoredRule does not exist yet
semanticAssessment: 71 tests ran, 43 passed, 14 assertion failures, 14 errors. The target (preservation, both rows) passed its fixture guards (both keys generated, cancellation recorded, UID line UID:{id}-{key}@domain) and then failed on assertNotified: the forced save of a BYDAY=MO / BYDAY=2TU rule was accepted (WR-10 reproduced). The 5 new page rows failed on the missing warning (page opened editable), the domain refusal rows failed with 'InvalidArgumentException not thrown'. The 14 errors are all 'Call to undefined method ManualRecurrence::tryFromStoredRule()' (the planned new API). The 3 existing unsupported rows, the supported-series positive control and the toRrule/fromRrule tests for the 2 new emitted rows (GMT and 25 Oct 2026 UNTIL) passed. No syntax, load, DB or fixture faults.
